name: Squid & octopus
description: Fast-growing cephalopods: the chokka squid (Loligo reynaudii) of the Agulhas Bank jig fishery, plus octopus and other squid. Functional group pooling the source's chokka-squid and other-cephalopods compartments (earlier models pooled them simply as 'cephalopods'); squid are eaten by almost everything large in this web, from hake to seals to tuna.
